Balsalazide is acted upon in the lower gut by bacterial azoreduction to produce mesalamine, the therapeutically active ingredient. Although no studies have been done, it is theorized that oral antibiotics can interfere with this reduction to mesalamine.

DDInter85.mechanism: Coadministration of 5-aminosalicylate with other nephrotoxic agents may increase the risk and severity of renal impairment due to additive effects on the kidney. The use of 5-aminosalicylate or its prodrugs has been associated with rare reports of renal impairment including minimal change nephropathy, acute and chronic interstitial nephritis, and renal failure.
